name: obsidian-gtd-clarify
description: Guided GTD Process and Organise steps for Markdown tasks in Obsidian.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=cjs --target=es2021 --platform=browser --external:obsidian --external:electron --outfile=main.js --log-level=warning --banner:js="/* Built from src/main.js by npm run build. Edit the source, not this file. */"
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json src/main.js

author: Greg A
